title: Quentin and the Landfall
author: C. M. Montrose
blurb: Ines Eastwick, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, has spent ten years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
